name: percent-bar-chart
title: 100% stacked bars
description: A 100% stacked bar chart for React that compares the mix inside each category. Hover or arrow through segments for share and value. Animated, accessible.
author: lokendra-builds <https://github.com/lokendra-builds>
docs:
100% stacked bars: https://lokendra-builds.github.io/sheenui/charts/percent-stacked-bar-chart

Installed in components/sheenui/charts/. Import (use your components alias):
import { PercentBarChart, PercentBarTable } from "@/components/sheenui/charts/percent-bar-chart";

Next.js: this item takes function props (formatters, seriesLegend(), a dashboard's load), and a Server Component cannot pass functions to a Client Component. Use it from a file that starts with "use client".
